text:
elaine (data-platform): Quick sync — we're targeting Thu 03:00 UTC for the orders table schema change. Need owners, smoke checklist, and rollback readiness. Dual-write window target 15m but ok to extend to 30 if needed. @raj can you confirm?

raj (eng-platform): I can take the cutover owner role. I'll be on-call + available for the window. Planning a staged cutover: migrate schema, start dual-write, ramp traffic, run backfill.

tyler (infra): FYI infra will provision the read-replica for backfill ahead of time (2x r5.large). ETA Wed EOD. I can run the smoke load generator during the window.

hana (sre): I'll own the smoke plan and rollback playbook. Key checks: replica lag <30s, 95p tail latency <200ms for api/orders, no errors in consumer jobs. Rollback steps: flip dual-write off -> truncate new columns writes -> revert DB schema change if needed.

elaine (data-platform): Thanks. Can we add a simple smoke script? Something like:
```bash
# quick smoke: create + read
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/orders -d '{"user_id":123, "items": [1]}'
curl https://api.redwood.example/orders/health
```
Run it after dual-write enabled.

raj (eng-platform): Added to my checklist. Also: backfill will run via job queue with concurrency 8. Estimated runtime ~40m; we'll do a canary backfill for 500 users first. If canary success -> full backfill.

sre-bot: Monitor alert rule "orders.replica_lag" enabled for the window. Notifying #eng-oncall channel when lag > 60s.

hana (sre): Can we also snapshot the primary before migration? small export just in case. I'll handle S3 retention and tag it with migration-id: orders-2026-03-25.

tyler (infra): Done — replica and snapshot scheduled. I also added an ip-restrict rule for the maintenance window (allow only deploy and SRE).

elaine (data-platform): Rollback readiness check:
- rollback flag tested? (raj)
- revert script reviewed? (tyler)
- team oncall at hand? (hana)

raj (eng-platform): rollback flag tested in staging, revert script located at:
```bash
./scripts/db_revert_orders_schema.sh --dry-run
```
I'll run a dry run Wed after the final preflight.

hana (sre): I will be oncall and will run the smoke script + verify prometheus dashboards. If anything flaps, escalate to @elaine and we stop traffic. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window Thu 03:00 UTC -> 03:45 UTC, owner: raj, checklists attached.

elaine (data-platform): Final ask: please post a one-line status in this thread when you start and when you finish the dual-write window. We'll also mark the change in the change-log. Thanks all. :pray:
